description: PeMS04 and PeMS08 Traffic Flow Datasets for Traffic Flow Forecasting is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors California Department of Transportation (Caltrans) PeMS. "This dataset consists of publicly available traffic flow data collected from the California Department of Transportation (Caltrans) Performance Measurement System (PeMS). It includes network-level traffic flow measurements recorded by loop detectors deployed across urban freeway networks. The dataset is widely used for traffic flow forecasting and traffic state estimation research. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
